Sentence (English): Having owned a Bosch dishwasher previously, I bought this one without a second thought.
Comments (English): [ Old Bosch vs. New Bosch ] || ---------------- || Having owned a Bosch dishwasher previously, I bought this one without a second thought. After 2 months, I can say it has exceptional cleaning power. I am less pleased with the design of the loading racks, nothing I could have forseen when viewing it in the store. The upper right fold down rack has a break in it; why? It leaves less area to lay things down in like long utensils, etc. The old vesion of the bottom rack was better configured as well. I am now doing a Jenga puzzle strategy to fit in bowls, plates, etc. Also not a fan of the untesil basket. It's too fussy. Would prefer an open design. I did try folding the currrent basket sides down; no go. The utensils just fall over and out of the basket.Could have purchased the next model up with a 3rd rack but could not justify $300 price difference. Live and learn.

Comments (English): [ Hmm. First of all, it's pretty and I like it. ] || ---------------- || User review. First of all, the design is surprisingly spacious and the colors are pretty. Our kitchen is mostly white-silver, but the orange accent really enlivens the atmosphere. It uses much less water than when I wash dishes. Unlike other countries where you have to fill the sink with water, rinse, and then wipe them dry, I soak them in water, apply a lot of dishwashing liquid, and rinse them, but it still uses a lot of water. I'm not sure about the electricity bill, but I think it definitely saves on water. Well, what's the point of a dishwasher if you just wash them and turn them upside down? I was thinking the same thing. But after using it myself, I was struck by the mindset of young people these days. Seeing the dishes come out warm and washed, the pleasure of pumping the water and creating bubbles... It's a different kind of satisfaction than washing dishes, isn't it? It was great. After-sales service review. All home appliances, once purchased, become a family member, just like a pet. You can't just settle for the best right now. They might break. I'm using it in conjunction with SmartThings, and when the dishwasher is finished, an alarm goes off on my TV and phone, so I have to clean up the dishes right after drying them. When purchasing, look at the model name to see the grade, so check carefully which options are added for each model before purchasing. Sentence (English): We purchased this dishwasher in addition to multiple other KA & JennAir appliances during all the COVID supply chain mess.
Comments (English): [ Lesson Learned ] || ---------------- || We purchased this dishwasher in addition to multiple other KA & JennAir appliances during all the COVID supply chain mess. Our appliances were purchased in January 2021 but we had to wait until September for everything to come in. 9 months. Everything was delivered at the end of September of 2021. The dishwasher looks great, however the heating element did not seem to be functioning very well, dishes were taking much longer to dry, we had to continually put the machine into extended dry and wait additional time, with plenty of items still wet once emptying. About a month in, we decided to contact the installation company, they stated that was "how they worked now-days". Well, we decided to go back to KA for a second opinion and they sent out a different company who stated that the heating/drying element was bad, and we had it all replaced. Fast forward now from OCT/NOV of 2021 to Jan 2023 and we are having the same issue again. Except now we are out of warranty. I contacted KA to see if there was anything they could do and received no such help. We will now have to pay ~$500+ to have this dishwasher fixed after having it for less than 2 years. Lesson Learned I guess when it comes to purchasing anything from KA. We have had an issue with our JennAir fridge as well as this and will most certainly be purchasing from another manufacturer for anything in the future. For the price, we expected a much better product and feel as though we have been scammed.

The dishwasher looks great, however the heating element did not seem to be functioning very well, dishes were taking much longer to dry, we had to continually put the machine into extended dry and wait additional time, with plenty of items still wet once emptying. About a month in, we decided to contact the installation company, they stated that was 'how they worked now-days'. Well, we decided to go back to KA for a second opinion and they sent out a different company who stated that the heating/drying element was bad, and we had it all replaced. Fast forward now from OCT/NOV of 2021 to Jan 2023 and we are having the same issue again. Except now we are out of warranty. I contacted KA to see if there was anything they could do and received no such help. We will now have to pay ~$500+ to have this dishwasher fixed after having it for less than 2 years. Lesson Learned I guess when it comes to purchasing anything from KA. We have had an issue with our JennAir fridge as well as this and will most certainly be purchasing from another manufacturer for anything in the future. For the price, we expected a much better product and feel as though we have been scammed.

Sentence (English): Love the outer looks of this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Bosch Dishwasher - Washes, but the Engineering? ] || ---------------- || Love the outer looks of this dishwasher. We had a prior Bosch, and it lasted forever. Once it dies, we went with another. This one, starting with the front, the plastic push buttons feel a bit cheap, and I'm afraid with time they may not last long. But I do love the washing features. On the inside, WHO DESIGNED THIS THING? Things do not fit like they should, everyday items like plates, bowls and cups are awkwardly placed like that junior high dance where no one knew where to go, or how to stand. The cutlery portion are apparentely the cool kids, because that's the only thing in the dishwasher that knows what to do. Overall, it's a good dishwasher that gets things clean, but after 2 months of using, it's still annoying to load.

Sentence (English): I don't know how I ever lived without a dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ I don't know how I ever lived without a dishwasher. ] || ---------------- || I don't know how I ever lived without a dishwasher. Of course, if you go into a large pot or frying pan, you can't put anything else in it, so you wash the dishes by hand. However, the noise is really loud, so you have to turn it on before the baby goes to bed, and it takes at least 60 minutes. The technician was kind and on time and installed it in 20 minutes. They also gave me a one-month supply of proche solid tax. I'm going to give it as a gift to my friends who are getting married. I recommend!

Sentence (English): Prior to this dishwasher, I had a Kenmore dishwasher that had a 39 dBA.
Comments (English): [ Great choice for me. ] || ---------------- || Prior to this dishwasher, I had a Kenmore dishwasher that had a 39 dBA. It was super quite and it was hard to hear in run while in the same room. That dishwasher cost several hundred dollars more. I miss that aspect of my last dishwasher, but the extra cost was not worth it. What I like about this dishwasher better is somehow it has more room inside. The middle rack, which I call the top rack allows me to put tall glasses and pans in without a problem. The third rack or top rack even has more room to lay large ladles. The controls are easier to use and I like that it has a timer display. Overall, I would say that for the features and extra room, that this is a better dishwasher for me. My old dishwasher was about 8 years old and started leaking it. As an extra level of protection, I purchased a dishwasher drip pan from Amazon. The tray will cause any water to flow to the front of the dishwasher so I can be aware of it to avoid potential floor damage. The drip pan was around $20. As for the installation, I had the totaltech so the install was included. The install is normally $150 at other stores, so it made ordering from BestBuy the best choice. The only problem with the install was that the installer said that new building codes required an outlet instead of a hardwire. If I new this was a requirement, I would have installed the outlet myself instead of having to pay the installer an extra fee to install. The installer did a great job and the extra fee was still cheaper than the install fee at other stores.

Sentence (English): This dishwasher is super quiet - so quiet that it has a red light to shine on the floor so you know it is on.
Comments (English): [ Quiet and effective ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher is super quiet - so quiet that it has a red light to shine on the floor so you know it is on. We love the silverware top tray that make sure the silverware gets very clean, and is also super easy to put away, much easier than baskets (P.S. baskets also come with this dishwasher if you prefer). It also has great space for a lot of dishes on the lower shelf. It is good quality with sturdy trays that slide easily. Also has a fold down wine glasses holder which is a nice feature. Why 4 stars instead of 5 -- it holds a lot less on the top shelf than our prior dishwasher, and even something like a bowl cannot angle up in the middle or it hits the silverware tray - it has to lay flat, which means a lot less room in the middle. We are still testing how clean things get with just a quick rinse - the jury is still out as some things come out great, and others do not (e.g., coffee cup with coffee stains). It also has a long cycle - 2.5 hours - for wash and dry, likely to be energy efficient.

Sentence (English): I love the low noise and the quality of the wash on this unit.
Comments (English): [ Passing info on seal / leak issue to look into ] || ---------------- || I love the low noise and the quality of the wash on this unit. I unfortunately started experiencing random leaks out the front door in first month of ownership. Upon inspecting the unit closely, I noted that the inner seal in the bottom corners of the washer is not locked into position and it appears that if this corner gets deflected backwards, leaks will occur out the bottom of the front panel. Once I shifted these corners forward so that they interfaced with the bottom seal on the door, the leaking problem appears to have been corrected (for now? - 3 washes since have been OK). Waiting to hear back if this can be permanently fixed so I don't have to check this all the time. If It were not for this issue, the unit has thumbs up otherwise - quiet, cleans well and 3rd rack is so darn handy

Comments (English): [ Highly recommended with only minor caveats ] || ---------------- || We've been using our Bosch 800 Series for a couple of months now. I'm pleased with the results. Our dishes come out clean, without water spots or stubborn bits of stuck-on food. On our model, the top drawer, a very flat space that works for things like lids and silverware, is a great feature. That adds to the flexibility of arranging things to maximize what we can clean in a single load! My old dishwasher had a "time remaining" display so I knew how long was left in a cycle, and I wish the Bosch had that as well. Our dishes come out clean, without water spots or stubborn bits of stuck-on food. The controls took a bit of getting used to -- it's important to read the manual! -- but it didn't take long to get accustomed to the settings. The dishwasher runs fairly quiet. On our model, the top drawer, a very flat space that works for things like lids and silverware, is a great feature. This allows us to take the silverware basket out and free up that much more space for plates and bowls.Because this model does not use a heating element in the bottom, it's safe to put plastics on all levels. That adds to the flexibility of arranging things to maximize what we can clean in a single load! My old dishwasher had a "time remaining" display so I knew how long was left in a cycle, and I wish the Bosch had that as well. I also find the touchpad controls in the top of the door to be a little sluggish in how they respond; that, combined with the lack of tactile feedback for a button press, can leave me unsure of whether I need to press again.That complaint aside, this is a very good dishwasher and I hope it serves us for a long time to come!

Sentence (English): Returned another brand and bought this one, it was clean and shiny, very satisfied.
Comments (English): Returned another brand and bought this one, it was clean and shiny, very satisfied. My husband cooks delicious food, but it takes half an hour to clean up the dishes, because he is afraid that he will be too tired to buy. Before buying it, he said that it was not necessary, and that the bowl was washed quickly. After buying it, the cup for drinking soy milk in the morning was not flushed, and he threw it all in for washing. No matter how you adjust the parameters of the previous brand, there will always be water stains and scales, and you have to go through the water again. I studied abroad before, and the rented apartments all have their own dishwashers, which at least meet the clean standard. So after repeated communication, I finally returned the previous one. My husband was still a little bit reluctant after returning it, and said that he could keep it even if there were water stains. Hurry and hurry to pick Haier for a long time, and urge the customer service to deliver the goods five times a day. Fortunately, the machine was cleaned very well this time. One hour of daily washing is enough to meet the needs. There are many functions and will be tested slowly later, and if there are problems, we will continue to evaluate. I hope everyone can free their hands, and the delivery master is also very kind, and he installed it as soon as it was delivered.
Comments (Original): 退了另一个牌子买的这个，洗得亮晶晶的，很满意。老公做饭好吃，但收拾碗筷半小时起步，怕他太累买的。买之前他说没必要，洗个碗很快的，买了以后早上喝豆浆的杯子都不冲水，全丢进去洗了。之前那个牌子无论怎么调节参数，总是残留水渍水垢，要再过遍水。之前在国外读书，租的公寓都自带洗碗机都至少达到洗干净这个标准。所以反复沟通，终于把之前那个退了，退完老公还有点舍不得，表示有水渍也可以留。紧赶慢赶挑半天挑了海尔，一天催五次客服发货。所幸这次机子洗得很干净。日常洗一小时就能满足需求。功能很多后面会慢慢试，有问题会接着评价。希望大家都能解放双手对了，送货师傅人也很好，送来顺便就给装上了。

I ordered on Costco.com I had issues with Costco 3rd party installers refusing to install because the plumbing line was copper. They refused to attach to it. I should have contacted Costco to see if that was allowed under their contract with them. They didn't want the risk of damaging the line They apologized saying I should have been asked if I had a copper li e before setting up install. I did not see anything about this in fine print so be sure to ask and double check or you could have the extra installation expense which is one of the reasons to purchase at Costco for the free installation in addition to their extended warranty. Not sure if Costco knows. This was for a vacation home so I couldn't travel down to meet with anyone until after return period. Oh and it went on sale within my return period but Costco said I would have to return it I order to get the $200 refund. Even though it wasn't installed yet I didn't want to hassle with all that it seems like a petty rule on their part. And inconsistent with their practice on other items. I could have had them pick it up to return for the price difference but I would have had to reorder wait for my refund and have someone meet delivery out of state. I didn't seem right to utilize resources out of their policy stupidity but so probabky should have. The regular price is way too high for the quality. I paid almost $900. The sale price was around $699. But I decided not to go stainless since my first GE died due to extremely hard water and mineral deposits killing the computer. Why bother if I'm going to have to replace often. Now I know in hard water environments you really do need yo do a monthly cleaning of your machine with products made to reduce mi real deposits. Performance is the big disappointment. Dishes do not come out clean even with heavy duty and steam settings. Not sure what to do. I only ordered GE because it matched the other appliances in slate. Only nice thing to say is it has a third rack. (But very shallow) I have a Kitchen Aid in my primary residence and I never knew I could love an appliance so much. For the price if you don't need to match Slate color do yourself a favor and spend the extra money on the Kitchen Aid. It's worth every penny I'm not sure what to do about the GE and dishes that don't come clean. They weren't that dirty but I don't want to have to pre wash everything. Will look at review and online troubleshooting but I would not recommend this unit.

Sentence (English): I've had this dishwasher for about 2 months and use it ~once every day or two.
Comments (English): [ cleans impressively well, quiet ] || ---------------- || I've had this dishwasher for about 2 months and use it ~once every day or two. I've been very impressed with it. It cleans better than most people clean by hand. I've found that even the "quick" 60 minute clean cycle is good enough most of the time. Only really stuck-on rice is sometimes a problem. Although I've heard Bosch makes quieter models, this one is aready very quiet. Downsides: I wish it could hold a bit more dishes---but it's sufficient for a family of 4 doing all dishes ~once per day. There are some far corners of the machine where cleaning is less than perfect. I also prefer the look of some other models (with controls hidden), but this one looks ok in a newly renovated kitchen. The value per price for this model is exceptional, and there is little to be improved upon in terms of cleaning and quiet operation.

Sentence (English): For the most part I'm happy with this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Mostly good ] || ---------------- || For the most part I'm happy with this dishwasher. I do wish I had chosen the next one up with the adjustable top rack though I didn't think it would be worth the extra price but I can't fit some spatulas in top rack there's much of an angle in the handle or if there's more than 2 pieces. There isn't much room between the rack & top of the dishwasher but that's my fault. I knew that when I picked it out. Also care needs to be taken need when placing spoons on the top rack. I thought it would be a quicker solution to just quickly throw them in. I was wrong. Spoons have to remain face down or you will be left with a puddle in any that aren't. I've spent more time turning them over, as they seen to want to land top side up. There also isn't a sprayer arm under the top rack, so the water has to reach flatware from the sprayer under the middle rack. There are 3 racks but only 2 sprayers. So if the middle rack is loaded too much, I suggest to use the side basket that's included for flatware on the bottom rack, or at least for spoons so they'll drain properly. I like to take that out, as it eats up room on bottom rack. It is really nice to have that choice though. My only other gripe is not brand related. I just wish all the tines on the racks weren't so tall. Seems all dishwashers come this way now. It's great for holding up large plates but have Villeroy & Boch Newwave cups that are toi wide on top yo fit between the tines and not tall enough. Same problem with some cereal bowls. They can be difficult to secure without them balancing & rocking on one tine. It would be nice to have some rows with shorter tines.Pros: It is very quiet. It has a decent amount of choices for settings, and cleans dishes very well so that most important. I also like the no-smudge finish. Fingerprints be gone! I understand no dishwasher can fit all our needs. There is always a price point I need to consider too, but a few tweaks would greatly improve this.

Sentence (English): We've been using our Bosch 800 Series for a couple of months now.
Comments (English): [ Highly recommended with only minor caveats ] || ---------------- || We've been using our Bosch 800 Series for a couple of months now. I'm pleased with the results. Our dishes come out clean, without water spots or stubborn bits of stuck-on food. The controls took a bit of getting used to -- it's important to read the manual! -- but it didn't take long to get accustomed to the settings. The dishwasher runs fairly quiet. On our model, the top drawer, a very flat space that works for things like lids and silverware, is a great feature. This allows us to take the silverware basket out and free up that much more space for plates and bowls. Because this model does not use a heating element in the bottom, it's safe to put plastics on all levels. That adds to the flexibility of arranging things to maximize what we can clean in a single load! My old dishwasher had a "time remaining" display so I knew how long was left in a cycle, and I wish the Bosch had that as well. I also find the touchpad controls in the top of the door to be a little sluggish in how they respond; that, combined with the lack of tactile feedback for a button press, can leave me unsure of whether I need to press again. That complaint aside, this is a very good dishwasher and I hope it serves us for a long time to come!

Sentence (English): For the most part I'm happy with this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Mostly good ] || ---------------- || For the most part I'm happy with this dishwasher. I do wish I had chosen the next one up with the adjustable top rack though I didn't think it would be worth the extra price but I can't fit some spatulas in top rack there's much of an angle in the handle or if there's more than 2 pieces. There isn't much room between the rack & top of the dishwasher but that's my fault. I knew that when I picked it out. Also care needs to be taken need when placing spoons on the top rack. I thought it would be a quicker solution to just quickly throw them in. I was wrong. Spoons have to remain face down or you will be left with a puddle in any that aren't. I've spent more time turning them over, as they seen to want to land top side up. There also isn't a sprayer arm under the top rack, so the water has to reach flatware from the sprayer under the middle rack. There are 3 racks but only 2 sprayers. So if the middle rack is loaded too much, I suggest to use the side basket that's included for flatware on the bottom rack, or at least for spoons so they'll drain properly. I like to take that out, as it eats up room on bottom rack. It is really nice to have that choice though. My only other gripe is not brand related. I just wish all the tines on the racks weren't so tall. Seems all dishwashers come this way now. It's great for holding up large plates but have Villeroy & Boch Newwave cups that are toi wide on top yo fit between the tines and not tall enough. Same problem with some cereal bowls. They can be difficult to secure without them balancing & rocking on one tine. It would be nice to have some rows with shorter tines. Pros: It is very quiet. It has a decent amount of choices for settings, and cleans dishes very well so that most important. I also like the no-smudge finish. Fingerprints be gone! I understand no dishwasher can fit all our needs. There is always a price point I need to consider too, but a few tweaks would greatly improve this.

Visually, the device is unobtrusive. The machine washes very cleanly even at 40 °C, the dish racks are extremely well divided and all the racks, really all of them, can be folded down (very intelligently: also divided), which means that the space can always be divided sensibly without bending anything. What I've never had before: The spikes have round beads at the top, which reduces contact with the dishes and the resulting small drying spots to a minimum. The cutlery drawer can be deepened on the side for bulky items. Actually, I would really like to give it 5 stars. I'm deducting one because this top model only achieves efficiency class B, while there is one in the 6 series that achieves A - albeit more expensive. The fact that the upper class is more inefficient than a mid-range device irritates me. There is also a deduction for the noise it makes: The machine is not as quiet as advertised; my old Siemens, which was a device class below this one, was supposed to be 1 dB louder on paper, but was considerably quieter than that These ones! In particular, a pump that usually runs at the beginning of the rinsing program and then again during active drying hums quite obtrusively, whereas all of the pumps on my old Siemens were almost unnoticeable until recently. This is disappointing.

Wcześniej miałem światełko na podłodze, które wyłączało się po zakończonym cyklu mycia, teraz dzięki wyświetlaczowi mogę dokładnie śledzić czas pracy zmywarki. Sentence (English): We bought this from KitchenAid directly after our previously owned 22-year old KitchenAid Superba dishwasher suffered metal fatigue and started leaking.

Since welding wasn't as good an option as I thought according to the repairer, we looked to KitchenAid's newest products. We're hoping for a 22-year run with this one, but only time will tell if that's to be. For now, it cleans very well but does suffer from what all energy efficient appliances do now; it takes close to 3 hours to do a normal load. The old KitchenAid Superba had it done in about an hour. I'll miss that when the holiday dinners come around again. If there was a deficiency to talk about I would say it's the soft stainless steel interior. In 3 months time I already have scratches from knives and metal cookware rubbing against the interior. Overall, it has been a good appliance purchase so far.
